description: This file defines data structures and functions related to Mattermost plugin manifests, including plugin metadata, settings schemas, and validation logic.

classes.name: PluginOption
classes.description: Represents an option for plugin settings, including display name and value.

classes.name: PluginSettingType
classes.description: Enumeration of possible plugin setting types (e.g., Bool, Dropdown, Generated, etc.).

classes.name: PluginSetting
classes.description: Defines a plugin configuration setting, including key, display name, type, help text, options, and other metadata.

classes.name: PluginSettingsSection
classes.description: Represents a section of plugin settings, including key, title, settings list, and display options.

classes.name: PluginSettingsSchema
classes.description: Schema for plugin settings, including header, footer, settings list, and sections.

classes.name: Manifest
classes.description: Main structure containing plugin metadata such as ID, name, description, URLs, version, server/webapp configs, and settings schema.

classes.name: ManifestServer
classes.description: Contains server executable paths and platform-specific executable info.

classes.name: ManifestWebapp
classes.description: Contains web application bundle path and hash.

methods.name: HasClient
methods.description: Checks if the manifest includes a web client component.

methods.name: ClientManifest
methods.description: Returns a client-specific copy of the manifest with adjusted Webapp bundle path.

methods.name: GetExecutableForRuntime
methods.description: Returns the path to the executable for a given OS and architecture.

methods.name: HasServer
methods.description: Checks if the manifest includes server configuration.

methods.name: HasWebapp
methods.description: Checks if the manifest includes web app configuration.

methods.name: MeetMinServerVersion
methods.description: Checks if the server version meets the minimum required version.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the manifest's fields and URLs.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates plugin settings schema, sections, and individual settings.

methods.name: convertTypeToPluginSettingType
methods.description: Converts string setting type to enum value.

methods.name: FindManifest
methods.description: Locates and parses plugin manifest files (YAML or JSON) in a directory.
